evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Background: Generative large language models (LLMs) offer an alternative to encoder-based clinical named entity recognition (NER), but their performance on fine-grained Japanese extraction tasks and sensitivity to generation settings remain uncertain.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Output-token limits materially affected comparisons with BERT, whereas enforcing output structure alone did not overcome low zero-shot accuracy.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Methods: We compared two fine-tuned BERT-CRF baselines with nine open-weight LLMs on iCorpus, which defines 113 entity categories.
